BrochureContent.Content:
Glenair House, built in the early 1800s, is a home of exceptional grandeur, discreetly hidden behind secure electric gates and set amidst approximately 1.5 acres of beautifully maintained grounds. Surrounded by a colourful array of flowers, mature greenery and thoughtfully landscaped gardens, the property enjoys a truly picturesque aesthetic. Adding further to the charm and character of the estate is its delightful gate lodge, which provides an attractive introduction to this distinguished period property. Rich in character and timeless elegance, Glenair House offers an exceptional sense of privacy, beauty and distinction.
 
Passing through the entrance gates, the house comes immediately into view, framed by generous lawns to either side and creating an impressive sense of arrival. Mature rhododendrons, hydrangeas and roses bring colour and character to the gardens, softening the landscape and providing an ever-changing display throughout the seasons. The driveway sweeps gently to the left, leading past the Gate Lodge before continuing to an additional parking area and the detached garage beyond. From here, a pathway follows the boundary of the grounds, winding through the established planting and leading towards the fountain. The grounds are the work of generations. Specimen trees stand where someone planted them centuries ago, borders that have been tended, layered and allowed to settle. In spring the beds come alive, in summer the colours change and the lawns run wide and green and in autumn the whole setting turns to a variety of coppers, gold and oranges. It is a landscape that cannot be designed into being, it can only be grown with time with each season providing a different type of beauty.
 
The house sits on a true east-west axis and the effect is felt from first light to last. Morning sun reaches into the principal rooms; by evening the gardens are still holding the warmth of the day. Throughout, the interiors extending to 338.2 sqm / 3,640 sqft approx. are filled with a soft, changing light that no modern build can imitate. Inside, the proportions are everything the period promises. Ceilings rise to 3.65 m / 12 ft. approx. Rooms are spacious, bright and beautifully balanced, with the large sash windows drawing the gardens indoors and the architectural detail cornicing, joinery, timber shutters intact and quietly confident. This is a house built at a time when scale, symmetry and craftsmanship were simply expected and it has been appointed to a standard that honours all three. Having been exceptionally maintained and upgraded by the current owners to include the love and care that has gone into maintaining the beautiful grounds this wonderful home is certainly one of its kind.
 
Upon entering you are greeted with a large and welcoming entrance hall this leads you through to all principle rooms on this level, a curved wall adds to the detail along with scalloped wooden fan feature either side of the door. The dual aspect drawing room is located to the right with double doors which lead you to the study. The main bedroom is located to the front, with access to a dressing room and en-suite. The second bedroom, located to the rear boasts both an en-suite and access to a balcony which overlooks the grounds. Downstairs there is an open plan L shaped kitchen/family/dining room with newly fitted Roundwood Design Kitchen complete with everything one might dream of, top of the range Neff appliances, an abundance of storage, large breakfast bar/Island, stunning Laura Ashley pendant lighting an aga which provides not only heat but a classic aesthetic that every kitchen should be complete with and bespoke cabinetry with lighting all complimented by an abundance of natural light as windows are placed on three sides. A sliding door is accessed of this room which offers a westerly aspect with covered patio area. There are two large bedrooms on this level one of which is complete with its own fireplace. A dual aspect living room with open fire is a cosy space to relax and also offers access outside. The family bathroom is on this level offering both a shower and a beautiful clawfoot bath and the boot room/utility room is the perfect space for everyday access into the home, there is ample storage for shoes and cloaks and access to a wc. Finally, the cellar which is located off the hall on this level is a deceptively large space which currently houses the current owners wine collection. 
 
The Gate Lodge of 50.7 sqn / 545 sqft approx. with beautiful stone facade is tucked away in the corner of the grounds. The L shaped kitchen/dining/living room perfectly utilises the space and boasts a warm and inviting open fire with floor to ceiling stone. There is a double bedroom which accesses a newly fitted en-suite and utility room with attic access is located off the hallway. This wonderful space could serve a multitude of uses depending on ones requirements whether its needed for a family member, au pair or even a home office or lucrative investment the possibilities are endless. 
 
Continuing on down the driveway you will find the detached garage currently in use a pool room and bar. Beyond the garage is large wooden shed perfect for all of your outdoor storage needs. The grounds are undoubtedly one of the defining features of this exceptional home, offering an impressive sense of space, privacy and tranquility. Expansive lawns, colourful landscaped borders and beautifully positioned sun traps create a wonderful outdoor setting, with inviting places to pause and enjoy the sunshine as it moves around the property throughout the day.
 
On arrival of the grounds the sweeping driveway is framed by generous lawned areas on either side, immediately setting the tone for the scale and beauty of the grounds. Mature planting and vibrant flower beds bring colour and interest throughout, with thoughtfully planted borders surrounding the house and edging the lawns to create a beautifully established landscape. A serene fountain, complemented by an elegant stone bench, provides an idyllic place to sit and enjoy the peaceful surroundings. From here, a meandering pathway follows the boundary of the grounds, leading alongside an exceptionally large expanse of lawn and through the colourful, carefully tended landscape. A substantial covered outdoor seating area provides a particularly inviting place to relax, dine or entertain while remaining sheltered from the elements. Adjoining this is a generous patio area, perfectly positioned to enjoy the sunshine throughout the day and offering a superb setting for long lunches, evening drinks and effortless outdoor entertaining. Steps lead gently towards the rear of the home, while pathways extend around the house, connecting the various areas of the gardens and allowing the grounds to be enjoyed from every aspect. Ample parking is available to both the front and rear of the property, comfortably accommodating multiple vehicles without detracting from the beauty of the surrounding landscape.
 
Beautifully established yet wonderfully spacious, the grounds offer an exceptional balance of sweeping lawns, colourful planting, peaceful corners and sun-drenched entertaining spaces a private outdoor haven designed to be enjoyed from morning through to evening
